reason: The plugin automates approval decisions in DeepSeek Harness by using an LLM guardian to assess requested operations, optionally inspect local read-only state, and silently allow low-risk actions while routing uncertain cases to the normal prompt.

summaries.zh: 该插件使用具备会话上下文和只读本地检查能力的LLM裁判，为DeepSeek Harness自动评估并处理工具操作审批。
summaries.en: This plugin uses an LLM guardian with session context and read-only local inspection to evaluate and automate tool-operation approvals in DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Automatically approves operations that would normally require user confirmation based on an LLM verdict
Provides the judging agent with session transcript context
Allows the judging agent to inspect local files, directories, and path metadata through read-only tools
Records approval decisions and related rationale in the plugin panel
